HediffDef.label: fragile replication material
HediffDef.description: This exact block Replicator body is assembled from comparatively weak physical matter. It moves slightly more easily but offers less resistance to sharp, blunt and thermal damage.

HediffDef.label: standard replication material
HediffDef.description: This exact block Replicator body is assembled from ordinary structural matter with no special durability advantage or penalty.

HediffDef.label: hardened replication material
HediffDef.description: This exact block Replicator body contains unusually durable structural matter. Its body resists physical and thermal damage better, at a small mobility cost.

HediffDef.label: ultra-dense replication material
HediffDef.description: This exact block Replicator body contains exceptionally resilient structural matter. It is substantially harder to damage, but the denser body moves more slowly.
